scores.tell: Chair fills about 70% and is centered with good margins, like the real cards. The empty floor band at the bottom is slightly large.
Slide and pool fill the card edge to edge and the slide is read first. The pool crops at the bottom edge and the scene is a little busy.
The dish is large and tilted, but the tower reaches the top edge and the base is buried in sand, so margins are tight. It is a scene rather than an isolated hero.
The signpost runs off the bottom edge and the arrow tips nearly touch the sides. The butterfly sits very close to the top, and the crop is tighter than real cards.
The glass is centered and fills about 65% of the card, with a clear first read. The umbrella and straw add small competing accents.
The UFO is centered, cleanly isolated on a flat background, with generous margins, matching the whistle and glove cards.
The hero is small, with the table about 35% of the card. Trees, path, and flowers fill the scene and compete for attention. The hierarchy is weak and the framing is wide.
The ship fills the card and reads at once. The sails nearly touch the top edge and the hull crops the sides, so there is little breathing room.
The door fills the whole card, so there is no negative space. The vines, lantern, and flower pots compete with the wreath for focus, and it reads as a scene rather than an object.
The gravestone is centered with a clear silhouette and a flat background. It is slightly small and sits low, with some empty space above.
